title: Fat-Soluble Vitamin Toxicity
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for fat-soluble vitamin toxicity.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for vitamin A and D toxicity mechanisms and clinical presentation; moderate evidence for vitamin E bleeding risk; low to negligible toxicity risk for vitamin K with dietary forms; emerging research on genetic susceptibility and metabolism variations.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
